title: task-223 completion: VAE, CGAN, HiFi-GAN, UniversalAudioTokenizer
content:
**task-223: Implement missing model architectures for torch parity** — COMPLETED

New files created:
- src/nn/vae.rs — VAE (VAEEncoder, VAEDecoder, VAE with reparameterization, ELBO loss, generate)
- src/nn/cgan.rs — Conditional GAN (CGANGenerator, CGANDiscriminator, CGAN with BCE loss)
- src/nn/hifigan.rs — HiFi-GAN (HiFiGANGenerator with residual dilated blocks, MultiScaleMultiBandDiscriminator)
- src/nn/audio_tokenizer.rs — UniversalAudioTokenizer (AudioTokenizerConfig, AudioTokenizerEncoder, AudioTokenizerDecoder)

All modules registered in src/nn/mod.rs with pub use re-exports.

Already existed (no changes needed): Mistral, Phi, Qwen, Gemma, CFGWrapper, UNet self-attention, cross-attention, MelSpectrogram, STFT.

Build blocked by missing MSVC linker on this machine — code follows project patterns (rand::Rng, Tensor API, Module trait).
